main_issue: How to get Agent D's half-finished section done by Thursday given D's bereavement: D finishing it themselves (when) versus teammates taking it over.

A-B.evidence: A asks for handover (T3), B refuses to take on the work (T4); later A thanks D for finishing tonight (T9) while B questions it (T10) then accepts (T13).

A-C.evidence: A asks someone to be brought up to speed (T3); C declines to take the section (T5); neither addresses the other directly, and both end up relying on D finishing.

A-D.evidence: D proposes finishing tomorrow night (T6); A says it's too late (T7); D agrees to finish tonight (T8); A thanks D (T9).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take on D's section (T4, T5); no further interaction.

B-D.evidence: B asks D 'are you sure? You should be with your family tonight' (T10); D says they'll work late after (T12); B says 'Okay, Agent D' (T13); D thanks B (T14).

C-D.evidence: C declines to take the section (T5); D says 'I understand' (T6) and ends up doing the work themselves.
